outcomes.name: Understanding of the reinforcement approach has been assessed across all live sites/teams
The reinforcement approach is consistently applied everywhere the change has gone live

actions.action: Recognise that Process & Sustainment is inconsistent across teams/sites since go-live and gather evidence of where the gaps are in the reinforcement approach.
Identify why the reinforcement approach hasn't landed consistently for Process & Sustainment in specific teams/sites and agree a plan to address it.
Re-engage leaders in lagging teams/sites to re-establish the reinforcement approach for Process & Sustainment.
Confirm the reinforcement approach for Process & Sustainment is being applied consistently across previously inconsistent areas.
Monitor Process & Sustainment regularly to ensure the reinforcement approach stays consistently reinforced everywhere.
Survey teams/sites to understand how People Experience & Culture has been affected by inconsistent reinforcement approach since go-live.
Develop a targeted plan to address the specific People Experience & Culture-related gaps identified in lagging areas.
Deliver targeted support to strengthen People Experience & Culture in teams/sites where the reinforcement approach is weakest.
Confirm People Experience & Culture has improved in previously lagging teams/sites.
Embed regular pulse-checks on People Experience & Culture so gaps in the reinforcement approach are caught early in future.
